ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the source report was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

session_id.description: CADIP acquisition session identifier the file belongs to (from SessionId)

name.description: File name as published by the CADIP service (from Name)

channel.description: Channel number the file was acquired on (from Channel)

block_number.description: Sequence block number of the file within the session (from BlockNumber)

final_block.description: Whether this file is the final block of the transfer (from FinalBlock)

publication_date.description: Date the file was published by the CADIP service (from PublicationDate)

eviction_date.description: Date the file is scheduled to be evicted from the CADIP store (from EvictionDate)

size.description: Size of the file in bytes (from Size)

retransfer.description: Whether the file was delivered as a retransfer (from Retransfer)

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced this record (e.g. CADIP_<station>_Files)

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the file, set to CADIP

production_service_name.description: Name of the CADIP ground station service that provided the file
